question_text: The ratio of the age of A 5 years ago to the age of B 4 years hence is 2:5 and the ratio of the present age of B to A is 12:7. Find the sum of the present age of A and B together.
explanation:
(2x + 5)/(5x – 4) = 7/1224x + 60 = 35x – 28
11x = 88
x = 8
The present age of A = 2 * 8 + 5 = 16 + 5 = 21 years
The present age of B = 5 * 8 – 4 = 40 – 4 = 36 years
The sum of the present age of A and B 
together = 21 + 36 = 57 years

question_text: The age of father before 18 years is 2 years more than 140% of the present age of son. Ratio of the age of father before 8 years to the present age of son is 2:1. Find the average of the present age of father and son.
explanation:
Present age of father = 2x + 8 
Present age of son = x (2x + 8 – 18) 
= [(140/100) * x] + 2 2x – 10 – 2 
=(7/5) * x 2x – 12 
= 7x/5 10x – 60 =7x 3x = 60 x = 20 
Present age of father = (2 * 20) + 8 = 48 years 
Present age of son = 20 years 
Required average = (48 + 20)/2 =68/2= 34 years
